tasks.prompt: Create the land-cover summary on target_grid.tif, using source.tif and the reporting policies in request.json. Deliver result.tif with the most represented valid class in each target cell.
tasks.inputs: Synthetic declared files: source.tif, target_grid.tif, request.json. Parameters describe user policies, not oracle controls.
acceptance: The independent oracle must evaluate every delivered numeric cell and its mask from the declared files.
The delivered spatial metadata and storage domain must meet the file contract.
tasks.pitfall: Categorical coarsening with fractional support and deterministic ties.

tasks.prompt: Produce a slope-angle map in degrees from elevation.tif using the central-difference and support policies in request.json. Deliver result.tif on the elevation grid.
tasks.inputs: Synthetic declared files: elevation.tif, request.json. Parameters describe user policies, not oracle controls.
acceptance: The independent oracle must evaluate every delivered numeric cell and its mask from the declared files.
The delivered spatial metadata and storage domain must meet the file contract.

tasks.prompt: Transfer the population counts in source.tif to target_grid.tif under the allocation and coverage policies in request.json. Deliver result.tif for the planning grid.
tasks.inputs: Synthetic declared files: source.tif, target_grid.tif, request.json. Parameters describe user policies, not oracle controls.
acceptance: The independent oracle must evaluate every delivered numeric cell and its mask from the declared files.
The delivered spatial metadata and storage domain must meet the file contract.
tasks.pitfall: Interpolating extensive counts instead of conservative area allocation.
